body.title: Confirm the whole surface end to end and ship the extension build
body.summary: RE-SCOPED per s3/t7: the per-task mutations now close their own tasks, so t7 CONFIRMS rather than discovers. It re-runs the full mutation set as one sweep, runs the complete vscode-plugin suite (not just the docs-review file) and reports the real counts, runs tsc, verifies all three rendered states visually, measures the VSIX delta and checks the diff's scope. Then rebuild the extension bundle and VSIX and reinstall. There is NO daemon rebuild in this Story — nothing under src/ changes — and shipping the wrong artefact would make the change appear not to work.
acceptanceChecks: The full vscode-plugin sweep passes, with the ACTUAL pass/total counts reported rather than asserted.

The complete mutation set is re-run as a sweep and every mutation still turns its named test red; any that has gone green since its own task is reported as a regression in the test, not quietly re-fixed.

Headless screenshots of the REAL rendered shell show all three states — requirements substituted in place under their own heading, no area at all on a document with no record, and the prepended block with its notice — and the images are actually read back, not just produced.
The VSIX size delta is measured and reported.
A scope check confirms the diff touches only protocol.ts, docs-review-panel.ts and its test file — no daemon file, no docs-sections.ts, no companion-slot groundwork for s3/s4.
The extension is rebuilt and reinstalled, and the report states plainly that no daemon rebuild was required.

tests.name: t7: the full vscode-plugin node:test sweep, with actual pass/total counts reported
t7: the complete seven-mutation set re-run as one sweep, each still turning its named test red
t7: headless screenshots of the real shell for all three states (in-section, absent, prepended-with-notice), read back as images
t7: tsc --noEmit clean, VSIX delta measured, and a diff scope check confirming only protocol.ts, docs-review-panel.ts and its test file changed
